summary: Net.Core defines serializer-independent complete-message ITransport and typed IMessageChannel seams. WebSocket reassembles continuation frames internally, uses a bounded awaited inbound channel for backpressure and rejects assembled messages above configured size. MessageChannel selects Sequential (one outstanding request, optional echoed-ID check) or Multiplexed (ID-correlated concurrent waiters). Protobuf codecs and WebSocket client/server remain separate adapters. GrpcTransport is a thin GrpcChannel lifecycle wrapper; it does not implement ITransport or duplicate gRPC framing/method dispatch. These component projects are render independent; Net.Elmish depends on standard Elmish plus Core, not FS.GG.UI. Current source version is 0.6.0, not proof of consumer activation.
title: WebSocket messages and gRPC occupy different network seams
